versions.name: Copycat
versions.text: Shuffle your starting hand into your deck. Add a copy of your opponent's hand into your hand (without buffs).

versions.name: Copycat
versions.text: At the start of the game, reveal your opponent's starting hand and shuffle a copy of it into your deck. Those copies cost 2 less.

versions.name: Copycat
versions.text: At the start of the game, reveal your opponent's starting hand and shuffle a copy of it into your deck. Reduce their cost by 1.

versions.name: Copycat
versions.text: At the start of the game reveal the first 3 cards in opponent's hand and shuffle a copy of them into your deck with -1 cost.
